channel.description: Latest articles from The Old House Life (theoldhouselife.com)

item.title: Pretty creek! Nice details! Two acres in Virginia. $115,000
item.description: That’s a pretty creek! This cabin is located in Virginia’s wine country. Work was started and the cabin is waiting for someone to complete it. The cabin was built in 1920. It is located on two acres in Troutdale, Virginia. The well and septic are already installed on the property and are waiting to be connected to the cabin. That’s a huge expense already taken care of. This could make a great vacation getaway spot and airbnb. I love the chimney. Big Laurel Creek is across the road from the cabin

item.title: Beautiful setting! Has a fruit orchard! Pretty area! Over eight acres in Virginia. $399,900
item.description: This house has such a beautiful setting! This is a really pretty area! There is a fruit orchard on the property! The house was built in 1900. It is located on 8.57 acres in Galax, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, stone chimney, wide plank wood floors, chair rails, crown moulding, wide baseboards, exposed brick, wood stove and a lovely sunroom. Outside you will find a pond, detached garage and a detached storage shed/workshop. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,155 square feet.

item.title: Multiple great outbuildings! Six acres in Michigan. $199,900
item.description: There are multiple great outbuildings on this property! My mind is running wild thinking about what I would do with them if they were mine. The house could use some updating and undoing of past renovations. The house was built in 1930. It is located on six acres in Litchfield, Michigan. There are hardwood floors, a fenced in pasture and a yard with trees for gardening or a play area for kids. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,504 square feet. $199,900 Contact Barbara Groves with Coldwell Banker

item.title: Pretty interior details! On five acres in Missouri. $250,000
item.description: Pretty interior details! Love the pocket doors and the leaded glass! The house was built in 1908. It is locate don five acres in Fulton, Missouri. The house features a wrap around front porch, original wood floors, pretty pocket doors, wide baseboards, leaded glass windows, transom window and a spacious kitchen. There is a large back deck and a detached storage shed. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,176 square feet. $250,000 Contact Cheryl Maupin with Real Broker: 573-239-1087 From the Zillow

item.title: Cute Montana house! Pretty yard! Circa 1915. $335,000
item.description: This is a cute house in Montana! Love the mature trees on the property! The house was built in 1915. It is located on .36 acre in Libby, Montana. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, baseboards, a spacious kitchen and a nice staircase. The house could use some updating and carpet removal. There is a detached garage on the property and mature trees. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,470 square feet. $335,000 Contact Sharron Sverdrup with Kootenai River Realty: 406-293-1150 Fro

item.title: 10 bedrooms/6 bathrooms! Circa 1901 in Nebraska. $560,000
item.description: This is a big house with 10 beds/6 bathrooms and over 7,000 square feet! The house was built in 1901. It is located on .41 acre in Omaha, Nebraska. The house features a covered front porch, a covered back porch, wood floors, baseboards, a grand staircase, vintage light fixtures, chair rails, crown moulding, french doors and unpainted woodwork. There is a detached garage on the property. I think the island in the kitchen should be removed. Makes the space too cramped. Ten bedrooms, six bathrooms

item.title: Circa 1767! This is beautiful! Over an acre in New Hampshire. $499,000
item.description: This is a beautiful house! Love the original details! Those fireplaces are amazing! The house was built in 1767. It is located on 1.4 acres in Swanzey, New Hampshire. The house features beautiful wood floors, paneled wainscoting, Quaker made cabinetry, built-ins, chair rails, amazing front door with original hardware, wide plank wood floors, screened in porch and a slate patio. There is an attached two car garage and a detached carriage house. Four bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,131 square feet

item.title: Montana’s most expensive old house listing! “A River Runs Through It” was filmed there. $6,999,900
item.description: Welcome to Montana’s most expensive old house listing! The movie, “A River Runs Through It”, was filmed at this location. The main cabin was built in 1920. It is located on 4.21 acres in Gallatin Gateway, Montana. The property consists of two main cabins, three guest cabins, a riverside bar and a sauna cabin. The property is situated on the banks of the Gallatin River and Hellroaring Creek. Five bedrooms, six bathrooms and 4,543 square feet. $6,999,900 From the Zillow listing: Nestled on 4.21 pr

item.title: Unique House! Circa 1935 in New Jersey. $400,000
item.description: This is a unique looking house! It has some pretty details! The house was built in 1935. It is located on .52 acre in Sparta, New Jersey. item.title: Pretty woodwork! Has a wine cellar and a humidor! C. 1910 in New Mexico. $289,000
item.description: Such pretty woodwork! How about that wine cellar and the walk in humidor. The house was built in 1910. It is located Carrizozo, New Mexico. The house features a covered front porch, hardwood floors, french doors, pretty staircase, built-in seating, exposed beams, built-in bookshelves, paneled wainscoting, bead board, crown moulding and a claw foot tub.
